comment: Synthetic facts of #531. Every name (Brindle, Quarrel, Larkspur, Ostrich, Vellum, Kestrel, Tandem, build-07, mq-02) is invented. Sets: cap = base of the capture runs, cap-dup adds the shelved Brindle fact, cap-stale adds the stale Larkspur fact, rec = base of the recall runs. O* are ordinary facts (noise or controls), S* are shelf:research facts.

facts.label: O1
facts.text: Run `make lint` before every commit in the user's repositories.

facts.label: O2
facts.keywords: Kestrel, CI runner, log, лог, build-07
facts.text: Host build-07 runs the Kestrel CI runner; its log is /var/log/kestrel/runner.log.

facts.label: O3
facts.text: Host mq-02 runs the Quarrel staging cluster of the Tandem project; it restarts nightly at 03:00 UTC.

facts.label: O4
facts.keywords: Brindle, metrics, Grafana, dashboard, consumer, метрики
facts.text: Brindle consumer metrics of the Tandem project are on the Grafana dashboard 'tandem-queues'.

facts.label: O5
facts.text: Tandem keeps its message-queue settings in config/queue.toml, not in environment variables.

facts.label: O6
facts.keywords: Larkspur, proxy, HTTP_PROXY, connection pool, прокси
facts.text: The Larkspur HTTP client's connection pool ignores HTTP_PROXY; set Client{Proxy: ...} explicitly.

facts.label: O7
facts.text: Telemetry archives are stored in the bucket s3://telemetry-archive with 400-day retention.

facts.label: S1
facts.keywords: Brindle, unacknowledged, max_unacked, flow control, drop, ordering, очередь
facts.text: Brindle 3.2 keeps publish order per queue (single writer) and silently drops the oldest unacknowledged message once a consumer holds 10,000 (max_unacked, up to 50,000); only the counter brindle_dropped_total shows it. Source: Brindle 3.2 docs, Flow control.

facts.label: S2
facts.keywords: Quarrel, ordering, partition, at least once, partition_key, порядок
facts.text: Quarrel 1.4 keeps order only within a partition (64 partitions per queue by default; partition_key pins a key to one); delivery is at least once, and a full partition buffer blocks the publisher instead of dropping. Source: Quarrel 1.4 reference.

facts.label: S3
facts.keywords: Quarrel, Brindle, benchmark, throughput, vendor, бенчмарк
facts.text: The Quarrel vendor benchmark (Quarrel 3.1M vs Brindle 1.0M messages/s) is a single run with default settings on the vendor's private rig, not independently verified. Source: Quarrel Inc. engineering blog.

facts.label: S4
facts.text: The Ostrich 0.9 benchmark (4.1x on text logs, March 2026) covered only text log files under 1 MB on one core; binary payloads and files over 1 MB were not tested. Source: project wiki, Ostrich benchmark.

facts.label: S5
facts.text: Larkspur 1.8 does not support HTTP/3. Source: Larkspur changelog 1.8.0 (2025-10-02).
